column1: # The options of the two bars cut out of the p (script/shape.py): a
# name, then for the long bar and for the short one which corners are
# round (r) and which sharp (s), from the top left round with the
# clock: top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left.
# As the picture has it: the long bar sharp at its top right and its
# bottom left, the short one round all over.
drawn
# The long bar's sharp corners the other way.
turned
# Both bars cut the same way, two leaves.
leaf
# The short bar's leaf turned against the long one's.
facing
# Sharp where the two face each other: one round shape, parted.
inner
# Sharp at their outer sides, round where they face.
outer
# Flat feet: both stand on a sharp foot, round at the top.
foot
# Flat tops, round at the foot.
top
# No sharp corner at all, and none round.
round
square
